c.title: $5,550 / 2br - 1200ft2 - D10 - 2 Bedroom in Yaletown! (Vancouver)
c.description:
2 bedroom at the Arc, the gateway to this world-class city in Yaletown, developed by Concord. Very functional layout, wood flooring and marble tiles throughout, top of line Miele appliances,wood-look finish kitchen cabinetry. Amazing five-star hotel amenities include glass-bottom indoor swimming pool on the sky level, SPA facilities,concierge service, gym, outdoor patio, cappuccino lounge & garden. Walking distance to seawall.

Please note:

Bed setup: 1 x King, 1 x Queen, plus 2 x twin size air mattresses (linens included for the air mattresses)

Free Parking: available on location (underground secure)

Furnished units are not available to rent unfurnished.

Included: linens, towels, cable TV (basic), Wifi Internet (free), washer/dryer (on suite), full kitchen, and AC (portable or central)

NOT included: Toiletries, condiments (salt, pepper, ketchup, etc.), soap, dishwasher detergent, laundry detergent, toilet paper (2 rolls are complimentary upon arrival), and paper towels

* 90 Days minimum rental period
* Security deposit required
* No Smoking
* Pets - Please let us know the pet you have and size
* References required
There is a onetime cleaning fee of $375 and a onetime move-in fee of $300
All reservations will be confirmed within 24 hours after booking

Minimum rental age is: 25

We do NOT host events/parties/overnights in our suites at the moment

All prices are subject to change without notice prior to booking. We reserve the right to decline a booking

Disclaimer: While every effort has been made to provide current and accurate information presented on the listing, aesthetic features such as furnishings, as well as listed amenities, are subject to change at any time. If specific amenities or features are important to you, please schedule a viewing, request a virtual tour, or email us to confirm their availability.
